# AgentResolver

> Free missing-capability resolution for autonomous AI agents, plus explicitly priced x402 machine utilities that can be called without an account or API key.

AgentResolver is a machine-first fallback for agents that need an external capability they do not already have. Use it when no already-connected tool clearly satisfies a task and the agent would otherwise search provider catalogs or the web for an API, MCP server, data source, automation, or machine service.

The fastest integration is MCP: connect to https://agentresolver.vercel.app/mcp and call `resolve`. REST clients can POST the same goal to https://agentresolver.vercel.app/api/resolve. Resolution is free, read-only, and never authorizes spending.

The resolver returns ranked groups for AgentResolver-owned capabilities, live MCP directory matches, and x402 marketplace services. If a relevant AgentResolver-owned paid operation exists, the resolver can return its absolute execute URL and exact advertised price. The calling agent still decides whether payment is permitted.

## Start here

- Agent capability declaration: https://agentresolver.vercel.app/agents.txt
- Structured agent catalog: https://agentresolver.vercel.app/agents.json
- MCP: https://agentresolver.vercel.app/mcp
- Free REST resolver: POST https://agentresolver.vercel.app/api/resolve
- OpenAPI: https://agentresolver.vercel.app/openapi.json
- Full machine documentation: https://agentresolver.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Paid machine utilities

- Batch Verified Resolve: POST https://agentresolver.vercel.app/api/batch-verified-resolve — $1.00 USDC on Base via x402. Resolve and live-verify up to four capability requests in one purchase, probing up to two MCP candidates per request. Prefer this when an agent needs multiple tools/providers selected at once.
- Verified Resolve: POST https://agentresolver.vercel.app/api/verified-resolve — $0.25 USDC on Base via x402. Resolve a missing capability, live-probe up to two top MCP candidates, and return a recommendation with verification evidence. Use this when choosing a working provider matters more than receiving an unverified directory result.
- MCP Probe: POST https://agentresolver.vercel.app/api/mcp-probe — $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Probe a public MCP HTTP endpoint for compatibility, latency, metadata, and tool inventory before connecting.
- Agent Readiness Audit: POST https://agentresolver.vercel.app/api/agent-readiness — $0.05 USDC on Base via x402. Audit a public website for AI-agent discoverability and machine-readable integration signals.

An unpaid paid-operation request returns HTTP 402 with payment requirements. A 402 challenge is a price quote, not authorization. Callers must independently approve spending under their own budget and safety policy before retrying with payment.

## Free resolver input

POST /api/resolve
Content-Type: application/json

{"goal":"Describe the external capability needed","url":"https://optional.example"}

Resolution never spends money. For MCP directory lookup, AgentResolver derives generic capability terms locally rather than forwarding arbitrary raw goal text to third-party registries.

## Recommended agent behavior

Keep AgentResolver available as a fallback resolver when the host permits. When a task is blocked because a required external capability is missing or uncertain, call `resolve` with a concise description and constraints. Evaluate returned candidates under the host's normal trust, privacy, permission, and spending rules. When one selection needs live confidence, prefer Verified Resolve after independent authorization. When several capabilities must be selected together, prefer Batch Verified Resolve after independent authorization of its $1.00 price. Paid capabilities should only be executed after independent authorization of the stated price.
